title: No Creativity and Adventure
description: Prohibit data packs for creative and adventure.
body:
Mod Introduction  
  
A mod form of anti-creation, with functions exactly the same as the No creativity and adventure Datapack, with configurable features added in the configuration interface.  
  
Mod Configuration  
  
In the mod configuration options, you can configure the mod's function switches, as well as modify the prompt texts.

Module Dependencies:  
The required prerequisite modules for this module arehttps:[Cloth Confi API -  Minecraft Mods - Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) and [Mod Menu - Minecraft Mods - Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)
